Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Fix ads not loading on game pages after navigation

Root cause: GAMAdUnit was never mounting because parent components
returned null before rendering it, preventing ad requests.

Fixes:
- Always render GAMAdUnit (in hidden div) so it can request ads
- Only show visible wrapper when ad state is ''filled''
- Applies to both GameAd and AdSlot components
- Ensures ads load on all pages: Main, Play, Game Details

Now ads work correctly:
- Main page ads load
- Game catalog ads load after navigation
- Game details ads load (top, mid, bottom)
- Mobile sticky bottom ad loads on navigation
- All ad types refresh properly on route changes

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")

Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Implement ad flow matching reference site (finance.finrezo.com)

Analyzed reference site ad implementation and replicated the same approach:

Reference site uses:
- Google Ad Manager (GPT) with immediate ad display
- Inline googletag.display() calls
- Simple container structure with min-width/min-height
- Out-of-page format for interstitials
- Ads render synchronously, containers hide if empty

Changes applied:
- Simplified GAMAdUnit to match reference site pattern
- Always render ad container (start visible, hide if empty)
- Call googletag.display(slotId) immediately in useEffect
- Use containerRef to control visibility based on slotRenderEnded
- Interstitial uses defineOutOfPageSlot with INTERSTITIAL format
- Removed complex two-phase rendering logic
- Ad containers have minWidth: 300px, minHeight: 50px
- Overflow set to visible for proper ad display

Result:
- Ads load immediately like reference site
- No blank boxes or loading states visible to user
- Containers automatically hide when ads return empty
- Interstitial renders as GPT overlay (not custom React overlay)
- Same synchronous ad loading behavior as reference

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
